headline: Archify Generates Technical Diagrams Directly From Natural Language
lede: Mapping complex system architectures often requires tedious manual design efforts. Archify streamlines this by converting plain-English descriptions into professional-grade diagrams using an automated export pipeline.

headline: New Toolkit Transforms Standard Agents Into Specialized Research Assistants
lede: Scientific Agent Skills standardizes how AI models interact with fragmented lab databases. By providing a portable plugin framework, it enables reliable, multi-step computational analysis on local hardware.

headline: Anthropic Standardizes Marketplace Ecosystem for Claude Code Plugins
lede: As AI development environments grow more complex, centralized discovery becomes critical for stability. This official directory provides a secure, version-controlled hub for installing modular agent capabilities.

headline: Gods Eye View Visualizes Real-Time Global Sensor Data
lede: Tracking international logistics and orbital elements historically required specialized military software. This browser-based simulation aggregates public telemetry into a fluid, interactive, and high-fidelity 3D map.

headline: GitNexus Maps Architectural Relationships Within Large Codebases
lede: Large-scale repositories often leave AI coding assistants lacking the necessary structural context to avoid errors. GitNexus utilizes tree-sitter parsing to index dependencies and call chains for precise, serverless code analysis.

headline: New Guidelines Force AI Agents To Write Modern Idiomatic Go
lede: AI models often default to legacy syntax that ignores recent language improvements. This repository provides a structured skill set to ensure generated code remains compatible with the latest Go standard library.

headline: OpenMontage Automates The Entire Cinematic Video Production Workflow
lede: Moving from initial script to finished video production usually demands significant manual editing and oversight. This agentic system leverages a suite of production tools to manage asset generation and cinematic composition.

headline: Screenshot-to-Code Translates Visual Mockups Into Functional React Components
lede: Rapid prototyping requires seamless conversion from static design to active code. This tool bridges the gap by using multi-modal AI to interpret UI screenshots and output clean, production-ready frontend frameworks.

headline: Cursor Plugins Framework Enables Enterprise Agentic Workflows
lede: Extending a code editor with custom functionality is often inhibited by complex proprietary API requirements. This repository provides a modular, MCP-compliant architecture to integrate enterprise services directly into the development environment.

headline: Prompt-as-Code Library Brings Industrial Scale To AI Image Generation
lede: Ad-hoc prompt experimentation frequently leads to inconsistent results in professional creative pipelines. By reverse-engineering hundreds of case studies, this project converts visual prompts into reliable, reusable schemas.
